description: Advisories `npm run supply-chain:npm` accepts for now (scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs). Take the fix first; list an advisory here only when there is none. An entry is { "id": "GHSA-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx", "package": "<the package the advisory is on>", "reason": "<why it is acceptable here>", "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD" } with the date at most 90 days out. An expired entry fails the gate and allows nothing.
